messages:
ethan-ae: Pinging the group — Suncrest RFP draft is attached. Main open items: HSM integrations, burst pricing tiers, POC dataset access, and the capability matrix alignment. Can folks scan?

maya-se: Got it. I'll focus on the POC ops/runbook section and the matrix rows for autoscale + burst. Do we have a sample SOW to reference for timelines?

ethan-ae: Not yet — law is pulling SOW later today. Laura, can you share any precedent SOWs for Dedicated + Private combos?

laura-legal: I have two redacted SOW templates (enterprise + midsize). Sharing link in a sec. Note: payment milestones differ if they take reserved capacity.

laura-legal: https://redwood.internal/sow-templates/enterprise-redacted.pdf :eyes:

maya-se: Thanks. For POC access — Suncrest asked for temporary dataset ingress and a 2-week dedicated sandbox with ingress egress logs. We should confirm cost and security gating.

priya-security: On dataset ingress: we can allow scoped transfer via pre-signed S3 + VPC peering during POC. Need their security contact to sign the data handling addendum. Also require KMS key policy review for HSM fallback.

ethan-ae: Who owns the addendum? Can we attach a one-pager to the RFP?

priya-security: I can draft a short addendum today. It will say: limited retention, delete-on-complete, audit logs retained 90 days by default, options for longer retention if contracted. Also include encrypted transit + at-rest, HSM integration notes.

sam-product: Quick note on capability matrix rows — I'm tightening definitions so Suncrest doesn't misinterpret "burst" as unlimited. Proposed cells: baseline throughput (tokens/sec), burst window (minutes), guaranteed slots, and fallback model variant. Example snippet:

```
| Feature | Baseline TPS | Burst window | Guaranteed slots | Fallback |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Hosted (shared) | 500 t/s | 2 min | best-effort | 7B quantized |
| Dedicated (reserved) | 5k t/s | 15 min | SLA-backed (p99 latency) | compatible model family |
| Private (VPC) | depends on infra | n/a | customer-provisioned | none (customer controls) |
```

maya-se: That matrix looks good. We should add a Notes column about cost delta and how caching affects token economics.

ethan-ae: Suncrest also asked for burst pricing example for 2M tokens/day POC with 30% peak bursts. Anyone have a quick estimate?

maya-se: Rough calc: baseline committed cost + burst egress on top. For Dedicated POC, estimate: $12k/mo reserved for baseline, burst premium ~ $0.03/token during peak (back of napkin). I'll formalize in spreadsheet.

priya-security: Also confirm their compliance needs — they flagged SOC2 + FedRAMP readiness questions. We should include current attestation docs and a roadmap for FedRAMP (if asked).

ethan-ae: I'll attach SOC2 report and the security FAQ. Priya, can we state FedRAMP as "roadmap — vendor assessment in progress"?

priya-security: Yes. Phrase as: "We maintain SOC2 Type II; FedRAMP authorization is being evaluated for our Private offering with target timeline Q4 next year. We will engage through our compliance channel for any accelerated path."

laura-legal: Minor contract note — HSM passthrough requires explicit language in the KMS section. I'll add a clause and flag options for customer-managed keys vs Redwood-managed HSM.

ethan-ae: Great. @maya-se please update the RFP matrix and ops notes. I'll run a quick pass on pricing and attachments.

maya-se: Will do. ETA 2pm PT. Adding a short runbook entry for POC teardown: steps to revoke peering, delete objects, rotate keys.

deploy-bot: deploy-poc-env: sandbox-suncrest created (id: sbx-3421). Logs forwarding enabled to ops-elastic.

ethan-ae: Nice — thanks bot. Last ask: Suncrest wants a short answer on model quantization and quality tradeoffs. Sam, can you draft 2 sentences we can paste?

sam-product: Sure: "We support multiple quantization profiles; 8-bit and 4-bit configs reduce GPU memory and cost with minimal quality impact for many conversational workloads. For customer-sensitive deployments we recommend validation evals — Redwood Optimize provides automated regression detection to ensure parity against a baseline."

ethan-ae: Perfect. I'll assemble the final RFP package with SOW links, SOC2, addendum draft, matrix, pricing table, and submit to Suncrest by EOD. Thanks everyone. :pray:

maya-se: Quick reminder — include a short step-by-step for their infra team to run the POC (IP allowlist, peering CIDR, expected ports). I'll add it.

priya-security: Also ensure the copy of the addendum includes contact for security review (security@redwood.com).

ethan-ae: Noted. Closing loop after 5pm review.

laura-legal: If we end up doing a pilot with reserved capacity, ping me — pricing triggers different liability clauses.

ethan-ae: Will do. Thread closed after attachments sent.
